description: Plan 9.10 / X-MB2 acceptance: the planar reaction-wheel balancer on the J-MB6 composites. GroundPlanar -> Pivot (Revolute2DCompliant, compliant pivot kt = 1e9 N/m, bt = 5e3 N s/m) -> LinkB (FixedJoint2D to the body centre of mass 0.3 m above the pivot, body frame x along the link) -> BodyJ (1-junction) with Body (RigidBody2D: m = 1.5 kg, J = 0.02 kg m^2) and WheelJ (Revolute2DCompliant whose axis is 0.2 m further along the body frame, i.e. 0.5 m above the pivot) -> Wheel (RigidBody2D: m = 0.4 kg, J = 0.002 kg m^2, its centre on the axis). The body pose is composed from the pivot angle (JointPose2D -> ComposePose2D) and feeds Body.g and PoseW (the wheel frame, composed with the wheel joint angle). Motor: MSe(tau) on the wheel drive; Balancer (project library, 1 ms) is a PD on the body angle with gravity feedforward G = 6.3765 sin(theta), torque limit 1.5 N m. Two variants: `balancer` (gravity on, starts 0.01 rad off upright, recovers, then follows a 0.012 rad reference pulse from 0.5 s to 1.5 s while the wheel spins up to 47 rad/s) and `balancer-free` (g0 = 0 everywhere, the wheel starts at 30 rad/s and the same pulse makes it spin down to 25.5 and back up to 34.5 rad/s while the total angular momentum about the pivot stays at 0.06 kg m^2/s).

checks.note: the balancer starts 0.01 rad off upright
the plan's balance band: |theta| stays inside 0.02 rad for the whole run (measured max 0.011969 rad)
the initial 0.01 rad tilt has been recovered by t = 0.5 s (0.9 mrad left)
before the reference pulse the tracked error is under 2 mrad
the reference pulse holds 0.012 rad from 0.5 s to 1.5 s
the wheel starts at rest
the wheel spins up to 47.05 rad/s while the body stays inside the band
after the manoeuvre it keeps the momentum the gravity impulse gave it (46.21 rad/s)
the motor torque never exceeds its 1.5 N m limit (measured max 0.2687 N m)
the wheel speed stays under 50 rad/s, so its stored energy is at most 1/2 J w^2 = 2.5 J

bounded form: E = KE_body + KE_wheel + PE + 1/2 kt |d|^2 starts at 6.3762 J (the upright potential) and peaks at 8.5877 J when the wheel carries its 47 rad/s; with the wheel-speed bound of 50 rad/s the stored energy is at most 2.5 J, so E <= 6.376 + 2.5 = 8.88 J (the check uses 8.9 J)
both compliant pivots keep every state integral (no W201), the chain is connected and unit-clean, the initialisation succeeds and the two pulse edges fire once each (no W206)
with gravity off the body starts upright
the wheel starts at 30 rad/s (the body inertia that carries the momentum is 0.257 kg m^2)
the body stays inside the same 0.02 rad band while the momentum is exchanged (measured max 0.011967 rad)
the pulse leans the body positive and the wheel spins down to 25.99 rad/s
as the body returns the wheel spins back up through 32.70 rad/s
the exchange is closed: the wheel is back at its 30 rad/s
the motor torque stays inside the 1.5 N m limit (measured max 0.1924 N m)

total angular momentum about the pivot with gravity off: H = (J_b + m_b lc_b^2 + m_w L_w^2 + J_w) theta_dot + J_w wheel_rate = 0.257 theta_dot + 0.002 wheel_rate = 0.06 kg m^2/s at t = 0. The motor torque is internal to the body+wheel pair, so H must stay constant while the wheel exchanges momentum with the body; measured max|H - H0| = 5.27e-9, i.e. 8.78e-8 of H (tol 1e-6)
the gravity-off variant reports the same clean diagnostics
